pages.title: Life in the Blood
pages.text: Hydra fangs can poison prey and draw life from it. A dragon heart binds both powers to the wearer: venom passes through melee strikes and direct flame. With an empty main hand, life taken by melee strikes also mends the dragon's own injuries.

pages.title: Life from Battle
pages.text: Melee hits and direct combat breath inflict Poison II for 6 seconds. With an empty main hand, the wearer heals for 20%% of the health an enemy actually loses to melee attacks; an off-hand shield is allowed.
Breath, burning and poison do not heal. It cannot be worn with healing accessories such as the Natural Dragon Heart Necklace.

pages.title: Venom Ward
pages.text: This heart answers only fire dragons. Wearing it clears existing poison and prevents new Poison effects.$(br2)Its protection and venomous attacks remain active while a weapon is held. Only life steal requires an empty main hand.
